text_block_list.text: On the way home. Called over by Nice Nature, I found myself at a flea market hosted by the shopping district alongside Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, how is it? How does the best bread in the shopping district taste?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh~~! That was delicious!
The apricot jam served with it was exquisite too...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Right~? It's so delicious, right~?
...Or at least, it should be, huh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: If only someone would come to eat it... well, yeah.
choice_data_list: Now that you mention it, the customers have really thinned out...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
True, the whole flea market does seem pretty deserted...
But why? With food this delicious, it ought to be super popular!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a big event going on nearby,
so people are heading over there.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
This flea market is also meant to promote the
upcoming Shopping District Grand Appreciation Festival.
Still, at this rate...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let's keep at it without getting discouraged!
There are customers who appreciate it like this, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, excuse me!
Won't you leave it to me!?"
choice_data_list: Do you have something in mind?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Please come too, Trainer!
And buy some extra bread and jam—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I've set out the bread and jam too.
All that's left is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer-san!
Let's just eat our hearts out!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Apricot jam, strawberry jam, kiwi jam, and blueberry jam! It's all-you-can-spread!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Which one should we start with?
How about the classic strawberry jam?

Saying that, Kitasan Black handed me a slice of bread spread with strawberry jam.
I took a bite as offered, and—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...How about it?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
You're right, it looks delicious...
I wonder if they're selling it at an event?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I bought this at the flea market over there~!
They've got delicious food and plenty of great finds!

text_block_list.name: Passerby
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... they had something like that going on?
Want to check it out for a bit?"
choice_data_list: Amazing, we managed to bring in a group...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's keep going like this!
I'm going to change spots for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: *Phaaar*~! This kiwi jam bread really hits the spot for a tired body~♪
choice_data_list: It's nicely tart with a clean aftertaste.
It's nicely tart with a refreshing aftertaste, too.

text_block_list.name: Person Jogging
text_block_list.text:
"Huh... for some reason,
I'm starting to get hungry."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Please, have one if you'd like.
I bought these at that flea market over there...
(*Chatter, chatter... Buzz, buzz...*)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait, the crowd's getting bigger...!
Kitasan, what on earth did you do in such a short time?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! When a place looks this fun,
you just can't help wanting to check it out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Even if you're busy, if you hear people having fun,
don't you just end up wanting to go check it out?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The moment you think, "What's going on over there?"
or "Maybe I'll take a quick look?"...
You're already a festival participant!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The passion in the air will carry the rest! We just need to proudly enjoy ourselves and pump up the heat as much as possible!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So powerful...! But this is quite educational.
choice_data_list: So that's why you were horsing around outside.
So that's why you were having so much fun outside.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
But it only got this lively thanks to everyone in the shopping district!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Your bright customer service, and all the love you poured into your products.
That's why this became such a huge success.
...At least, that's what I think!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Good grief, you certainly don't hold back.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
A friendly, warmhearted atmosphere
is what this shopping district is all about!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Once the customers show up,
the rest will be a breeze~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So yeah... thanks.
Looks like we'll manage the upcoming festival somehow.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Not at all! It's my way of saying thanks for the delicious bread and jam!
choice_data_list: What a classy way to say thanks!
What a stylish way to say thanks!
Well, touting for customers was pretty fun, too.
Well, touting for customers was pretty fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Not at all! It's my way of saying thanks for the delicious bread and jam!
choice_data_list: What a classy way to say thanks!
What a stylish way to say thanks!
Well, touting for customers was pretty fun, too.
Well, touting for customers was pretty fun, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! ...Refined, you say?
Ehehe, aww, I've still got a long way to go...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yo! Lookin' sharp, boss!
Puff out that chest with some pride!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, r-really~?
Then I'm gonna take your word for it, okay? Tee-hee~!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Dad... do you think I managed
to be even a little bit like you?)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"That's right!
As expected of you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Kindness is its own reward.
After all, it's so we can have fun too, right!
